name: Kopi O
description: Coffee beans roasted with sugar and margarine, brewed strong and drunk black.

tcm.note: Read with coffee; the caramel roast adds warmth.

histamine.note: Read as coffee; typically robusta, so the caffeine end runs high.

stimulant.note: Caffeine alone; typically robusta, so the dose runs high.

guna.note: Stimulating, which is the definition of rajasic rather than a judgement on it.
